title: Anubhav Srivastava (Founder, Uptales · Expert Economy OS) — 'The best companies, and the best people, are built on structure AND ethics'
summary: Anubhav Srivastava — founder of Uptales ('The OS of the Expert Economy') — publishes a Richard-Branson-inspired essay on his 'no asshole policy' and lands on Incorruptible as the reason it now feels non-negotiable. Third publicly-surfaced Incorruptible Early Stage Founders Cohort attendee this week (after Federica Torgneur and Frida Halltorp).
blockquote: This is exactly why Eric Ries's work hit me so hard. I read Incorruptible. I sat through an excellent cohort ran by him. And the core lesson stayed with me: The best companies, and the best people, are built on structure AND ethics. Not one or the other.
attribution_title: Founder, Uptales — The OS of the Expert Economy
